title: Pig wearing a party hat
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- pig body -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='68' rx='28' ry='22' fill='#ff9ec0'/>
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='68' rx='28' ry='22' fill='none' stroke='#ffc2d8' stroke-width='2'/>
  <!-- legs -->
  <rect x='32' y='84' width='9' height='10' rx='4' fill='#ff86b0'/>
  <rect x='59' y='84' width='9' height='10' rx='4' fill='#ff86b0'/>
  <!-- hooves -->
  <rect x='32' y='90' width='9' height='4' rx='2' fill='#e05a8a'/>
  <rect x='59' y='90' width='9' height='4' rx='2' fill='#e05a8a'/>
  <!-- head -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='45' r='22' fill='#ffb0cc'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='45' r='22' fill='none' stroke='#ffd0e2' stroke-width='2'/>
  <!-- ears -->
  <path d='M32 30 Q26 16 38 24 Z' fill='#ff86b0'/>
  <path d='M68 30 Q74 16 62 24 Z' fill='#ff86b0'/>
  <!-- eyes -->
  <circle cx='42' cy='42' r='3' fill='#6b2a44'/>
  <circle cx='58' cy='42' r='3' fill='#6b2a44'/>
  <circle cx='43' cy='41' r='1' fill='#ffd0e2'/>
  <circle cx='59' cy='41' r='1' fill='#ffd0e2'/>
  <!-- snout -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='53' rx='11' ry='8' fill='#ff86b0'/>
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='53' rx='11' ry='8' fill='none' stroke='#ffc2d8' stroke-width='1.5'/>
  <ellipse cx='46' cy='53' rx='2' ry='3' fill='#c93f70'/>
  <ellipse cx='54' cy='53' rx='2' ry='3' fill='#c93f70'/>
  <!-- mouth -->
  <path d='M45 60 Q50 64 55 60' fill='none' stroke='#c93f70' stroke-width='2' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- party hat -->
  <path d='M38 26 L50 4 L62 26 Z' fill='#ffe066'/>
  <path d='M38 26 L50 4 L62 26 Z' fill='none' stroke='#fff3b0' stroke-width='1.5'/>
  <!-- hat bands -->
  <path d='M40 22 L60 22' stroke='#66d9e8' stroke-width='3' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M42 16 L58 16' stroke='#ff6b9d' stroke-width='3' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M44 10 L56 10' stroke='#66d9e8' stroke-width='2.5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- hat pom -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='4' r='4' fill='#ff6b9d'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='4' r='4' fill='none' stroke='#ffb0cc' stroke-width='1'/>
  <!-- hat brim -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='27' rx='13' ry='3.5' fill='#ffd43b'/>
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='27' rx='13' ry='3.5' fill='none' stroke='#fff3b0' stroke-width='1'/>
</svg>
